title: Add worker registry, queue limits and evidence reporting
description: Add a worker registry with per-project concurrency limits, a bounded queue, and an evidence record per task (files changed, commands run, verification output). Only one active task per project exists today; queue limits and evidence reporting do not.
why: The assistant needs a trustworthy answer to who is working and whether the result is usable.

acceptance.text: A second write task waits for the first workspace lease
Worker unavailability is visible before dispatch
Timeout and cancellation release owned resources
A claimed success without required evidence stays unverified

outcome.summary: Per-project FIFO queue for write tasks, identical retries reuse the active task, preflight before dispatch, per-task timeout with reason, git-based changed-file evidence; success stays unverified.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; test:context 11/11; test:policy 18/18 (1 symlink skipped); test:acp 7/7; test:plantool 5/5
